title: 14729-D9831C00002- 1 Month Biopsy Study
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to study histological changes, cellularity, clinical efficacy and safety of AZD1981 in patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men or women 40 years or above
* FEV1 between 40 and 80% of predicted normal value post-bronchodilator
* Clinical diagnosis of COPD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other clinically relevant disease or disorders
* Exacerbation of COPD within 30 days
